definitions.explanation: An educational institution that is privately funded and operated, as opposed to public or national schools. Also refers to private education as a sector.

examples.japanese: {私学|しがく}に{通|かよ}っている。
{私学|しがく}の{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}は{公立|こうりつ}より{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Private school tuition is higher than public school.

examples.japanese: {私学|しがく}{助成金|じょせいきん}の{制度|せいど}を{利用|りよう}して、{学費|がくひ}の{負担|ふたん}を{軽減|けいげん}することができる。
examples.english: You can reduce the burden of tuition fees by using the private school subsidy system.

notes:
USAGE:
An abbreviation of {私立|しりつ}{学校|がっこう} (private school). Used in both educational discussions and administrative/policy contexts. Contrasts with {公立|こうりつ} (public) and {国立|こくりつ} (national).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私学|しがく}{助成金|じょせいきん} (private school subsidy)
- {私学|しがく}{経営|けいえい} (private school management)
- {私学|しがく}{振興|しんこう} (private school promotion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {私立|しりつ}: private (institution) — the full, more common term
- {公立|こうりつ}: public (institution) — government-funded schools
- {国立|こくりつ}: national (institution) — nationally funded schools
